Strategy: Add a smaller half-strength bonus just above the winning band, rewarding leftovers between forty-three and fifty-five at a quarter item. It may help by extending the good window upward, but may fail by rewarding bins that are too loose.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) + (item / 4 if r - item >= 43 and r - item <= 55 else 0) for r in bins]
```
